title: A new Friday the 13th film is coming in 2027
summary: Steve Miner, who directed two of the early films, returns to direct the thirteenth in the horror series.
body:
A new Friday the 13th film is planned for cinemas in 2027, the series' owners announced on Friday 13 November.

It will be the thirteenth film in the long-running horror series about the masked killer Jason Voorhees, and the first since 2009.

A familiar director

Steve Miner, who directed the second and third films in the early 1980s, is returning to direct from a script by David Fliegel.

The film is being financed and produced by Horror, Inc., with CatchLight Studios as production partner. Cineverse will release it in North America. No exact release date or cast has been announced.

Sources: Complex, JoBlo, Bleeding Cool.
author: ICONDAILY
